visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a tight close-up of yellowish-brown translucent tea being poured into a white paper cup featuring the 'Tao Tao Tea' brand logo. The liquid creates bubbles and splashes as it fills the bottom against a stainless steel background. (2) A metal ice scoop enters from the top right, dropping several large, clear ice cubes into the tea. The ice causes the liquid level to rise significantly, creating small ripples. (3) The scene cuts to a medium shot of four branded tea cups arranged on a wooden table. Some cups have flat lids, while others feature ornate floral designs in pink and white. A hand reaches in to adjust a cup against a solid bright yellow wall. (4) A creamy white milk liquid is added to the brown tea in a close-up shot, creating a marble-like swirling pattern of white and tan textures. (5) Multiple close-ups show ice floating in various tea blends, with condensation visible on the cups' inner rims. The lighting is bright and studio-like, emphasizing the beverage's clarity. (6) A hand holds two cups of tea in front of the tea shop's interior signage. The final shots show a wide view of the 'Tao Tao Tea' service counter, decorated with light wood and featuring tea tins on shelves.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a male narrator speaking in a friendly, professional tone. An upbeat acoustic pop BGM with a guitar and soft drum beat plays continuously. The distinct sound of liquid splashing into a cup is heard. (2) A sharp clinking sound of ice cubes hitting liquid triggers a transition. The narrator continues describing the tea blend's features with steady pitch and moderate speed. The acoustic BGM maintains its rhythm. (3) A lower-frequency bubbling sound occurs during a different pouring sequence. The narrator's intonation rises slightly as he emphasizes flavor details. A faint background hum of a commercial environment is present but low in intensity. (4) A brief metallic clink of a scoop is audible. The narration transitions to location information. The BGM remains the dominant non-vocal layer, providing a positive, energetic vibe until a clean final fade-out.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear branding through logos on cups, signage in store, and specific promotional content regarding a new product line with detailed location info.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-density subtitles and fast-paced editing typical of social media marketing. The combination of satisfying pouring sounds and vibrant tea imagery creates a sensory-focused appeal.
